wins: Performed full TCP port sweep and identified high-value services (SSH on 22, HTTP on 80) for focused enumeration.
Documented service banners and possible exploit paths with consistent nmap scripting output for mentoring review.
fails: Privilege escalation stalled after exhausting default credentials, leaving post-exploitation incomplete despite repeated attempts.
No successful lateral movement achieved; access remained limited to initial foothold due to segmented network defenses.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance provided a clear map of exposed services, but the kill chain halted at privilege escalation and lateral movement without credential or exploit breakthroughs.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly failed because credential and sudo enumeration yielded no viable accounts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with banner indicating Apache or nginx
skill_cards.then_action: Launch gobuster/dirbuster with wordlist for subdirectory discovery

skill_cards.if_condition: When a shell is obtained without obvious privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Run sudo -l and check for misconfigurations/binaries allowing privilege escalation

memory_ops.reason: High success in identifying usable services during reconnaissance and informing next actions
Consistent directory discovery provided contextual intelligence to pivot further

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting from exposed web forms
next_experiments.description: Test for stored credentials or misconfigured authentication endpoints on the HTTP service, possibly yielding reused credentials for sudo.

next_experiments.title: Automated privilege escalation with linpeas
next_experiments.description: Execute linpeas or similar script to discover kernel exploits, misconfigurations, or weak SUID binaries missed in manual enumeration.

next_experiments.title: Pivot attempt via SSH config reuse
next_experiments.description: Leverage SSH config templates and known banner details to attempt lateral SSH login using harvested keys or reused accounts.
